source: Navin, 27 October 2026: "a shop and its buyers, a bank and its borrowers, a factory and its workers, a port, a farm"; the petrol pump for the real-world application. Moved out of world.py on 2 November 2026 (Task 046 Part D2 addendum: no chapter noun is a fixed value in the world code).
how_it_is_used: bie/brain/video/world.py reads the words that name each place in a part's narration; a place with a kit goes to world mode (C), one without a kit to the canvas (B) and to the missing-capability log. The 'draws' map says which thing each world element kind draws, and 'whole_part' which kinds stand for the whole part; the coverage check reads both.

draws._: What each world element kind draws, by the words that name the thing (Navin's addendum of 2 November 2026, point 4): the coverage check (bie/brain/visual_thinking.coverage_rows) counts a thing of a beat as shown when an element of that kind is on screen during the beat and a word of the thing is one of these. A kit's own vocabulary, not one chapter's: a new kit adds its kinds here.

sites._: The words that name a place ITSELF (not its people, goods or deals: a farmer can stand in a shop, an import order can be placed in a bank). bie/brain/video/world.places_named reads these and 'elsewhere', as whole words, to say where a beat happens (Navin, 3 November 2026: no world for a place that is not that world).

people._: The people who are AT a place (its own staff and visitors), whose naming opens a world part's scene there (bie/brain/canvas_director.at_place); a place's deals (a loan, a deposit) or another place's people do not.

elsewhere._: Navin's verdict on the addendum proof (3 November 2026): "the shop world still hosts non-shop scenes (v6 mints, British Act, Mumbai bank)"; "no world for a place that is not that world". The places a beat can name that no world kit draws. A beat of a world part that names one of these, or another kit's site, is not at the kit's place: it goes to the canvas (bie/brain/canvas_director.world_split). Words are whole words.

whole_part._: World element kinds that stand in the street for the whole part (world.py's layout check and the coverage check both read this): a kit's place and the person who works there.
